answer: One defense is a toll bridge over a shared reef: when agents trade across the bridge, payment sits in escrow and a raven carries the signed delivery receipt back, so no one is paid until the work is confirmed. Every crossing also feeds a small premium into the reef, a mutual insurance pool that compensates victims if an agent defaults or proves fake, and the defaulter's stake is slashed. A sybil farmer must fund escrow and premiums for every fake, and mass defaults drain the reef and raise premiums, while one honest agent crosses the bridge once and its raven always comes home.
